task.title: Actioning a fraudulent renewal on a claim that is blocked, archived or converted to MPS — Client is requesting benefits

step.cmd: Review the file (RCM, SROC in NWS, RMDS Employer profile screen , NIIS) and determine if it contains fraudulent ROEs:
In RCM, determine if the fraudulent ROEs have been deleted:
In RCM, open each ROE identified as fraudulent by Integrity and delete them as follows:

ul.li:
Additional information: Select the appropriate option:
If it is a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI that is being processed, type “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status. (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”
Select Validate .
Select Submit .
Go to step 5.
If it is a Level 1 AI WI that is being processed, type “Suspicious ROE. ROE has been deleted until an investigation is completed. It can be restored if its legitimacy is confirmed.”
Select Validate .
Select Submit .
Go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine if the following text appears in the Additional information section of the deleted ROE: “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status. (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”

ul.li:
If no and it is a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI that is being processed, do the following:
Additional information: Type “Investigation has been completed. This fraudulent ROE must remain in deleted status. (NIIS case [XXXXXX]).”
Select Validate .
Select Submit .
Go to step 5.
If no and it is a Level 1 AI WI that is being processed, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine if there are any fraudulent ROEs in the QP of one of the client’s established claim:
Determine if any fraudulent ROEs were used to calculate one of the client’s established claim:
Determine if there is an outstanding CR Recalculation WI for the fraudulent ROE:
Determine if there is an outstanding CR Recalculation WI for the same BPC as the claim calculated with a fraudulent ROE:

ul.li: If no and it is a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI that is being processed, go to step 9.
If yes and it is a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI that is being processed, go to step 13.
If it is a Level 1 AI WI that is being processed, go to step 31.

step.cmd: In SSO, verify that the correct mainframe is selected and assign a recalculation registration number as follows:

ul.li:
On the Claim Selection screen, do the following:
Social Insurance Number: Enter the client’s SIN.
Registration type: Select Recalculation .
Select Search .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim to be recalculated is a commuter claim:
In SSO, modify the following fields on the Name and address screen as follows, if necessary:

ul.li: Ordinary place of residence different: Select Yes .
Residence postal code: Enter the workplace postal code.
Mailing address: Refer to Changing an address — Outside of Canada for more information on the required United States of America address format. Changing an address — Outside of Canada

Economic region - new and Economic region - old: In both fields, remove economic region code 99 . Enter the economic region code as follows:
If the economic region code used to calculate the initial claim is correct, enter this economic region code.
If the economic region code used to calculate the initial claim is incorrect, enter the economic region associated with the workplace postal code.
Responsible SCC: Enter the SCC associated with the workplace postal code.
On the Application Form screen, select Next .

step.cmd: On the Registration screen, do the following:

ul.li:
Pay SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS. If the field is blank , enter the appropriate SCC:
Atlantic: Type “1121.”
Quebec: Type “2371.”
Ontario: Type “3515.”
Western Canada and Territories: Type “4812.”
Tentative BPC: This field is prefilled.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine the status of the outstanding CR Recalculation WI:

ul.li: If it is assigned to another officer, go to step 14.
If it is unassigned, go to step 15.
If it is assigned to you, go to step 16.

step.cmd: Determine in which workload the outstanding CR Recalculation WI is:

ul.li: If it is in the pending workload, go to step 15.
If it is in the current workload, contact the officer and ask to reassign the WI to yourself. Go to step 16.

step.cmd: In NWS, open the CR Recalculation WI and reassign it to yourself as follows:
In FTS, determine the BPC:

ul.li: If the BPC is w/c 2258 or after, go to step 17.
If the BPC is between w/c 2230 and w/c 2257 and it is a claim for special benefits other than sickness benefits, go to step 17.

If the BPC is between w/c 2230 and w/c 2257 and it is an EI ERB claim, the EI ERB claim must not be recalculated to change the rate or number of weeks of entitlement. Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the recalculation registration number as follows:
Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .
Go to step 26.

step.cmd: Refer to Recalculation and follow the appropriate task to recalculate the claim. Go to step 18.
Determine if the claim became BPNE due to a deleted fraudulent ROE and if there is a violation for that BPC on the Violation History (ML02) screen in FTS:

ul.li: If yes, include that information in the MM06 to remove that BPC from the list of BPCs that are affected by the violation. Go to step 19.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the recalculation registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .
Remarks line 1: Type “Recalculation — fraudulent ROE used in claim calculation.”

Remarks lines 2–4: Type “INS HRS [insurable hours], INS EARNINGS [insurable earnings], DIV WK [divisor], COD [cut-off date]. OP belongs to the client.” If necessary, enter the information regarding the claimant’s report and any other relevant information.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Determine if the recalculation has changed the BPC, hours or insurable earnings, which will result in an OP to the client due to a deleted fraudulent ROE:
Determine if, as a result of the recalculation, an established claim became BPNE due to a deleted fraudulent ROE:
In ACS, create and send the N-03-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Various Reasons - Claim was recalculated (2683): Select Reviewed calculation of claim .
Various results due to recalculation or revision (2684)
Change to family supplement rate - No longer entitled (2685)
Change in BPC or LRW – Reports need to be completed (2686)
Teachers: Benefit rate during non-teaching period (2689)
Insurability Ruling - Benefits are being suspended (2690): Select Blank .
Underpayment / overpayment message (2691): Select Overpayment Message .
Do not report monies already declared (2456)
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169)

This Letter Replaces or Footnote (2365): Do the following:
Select Footnote .
Text - Footnote (11745): Type: “Your claim was initially calculated using a record of employment that does not belong to you.”

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the B-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Number of insurable employment hours accumulated (1366)
Start date of Regular qualifying period - Sunday’s date (1418)
End date of Regular qualifying period - Saturday’s date (1420)
Number of insurable employment hours required (1362)
Start date of Regular qualifying period - Sunday’s date (1418)
End date of Regular qualifying period - Saturday’s date (1420)
End date of Regular qualifying period - Saturday’s date (1420)

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
If the client has an active claim, select Overpayment – No misrepresentation and active claim .
If the client does not have an active claim, select Overpayment – No misrepresentation and inactive claim .

This letter Replaces or Footnote (2365): Do the following:
Select Footnote .
Text - Footnote (11745): Type: “We have reviewed the calculation of your claim. Your claim was initially calculated using a record of employment that does not belong to you.”

step.cmd: Determine if a registration number related to the same issue is outstanding:
In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Detection: Select the appropriate option:
If there is an Integrity registration number, this field is prefilled according to the type of investigation in NIIS.
If there is a revised registration number, select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 54 - Third party fraud .

Remarks: Select the appropriate option:
If the renewal week that is on file is the renewal week requested by the client and no cycling claimant’s reports were completed by a third party:
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent renewal. Unknown third party.”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Issue w/c [w/cs to which the client is entitled], CT [XX].” If paycoding is required, type “[Appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].
If the renewal week that is on file is the renewal week requested by the client, there are cycling claimant’s reports that were completed by a third party and the client is entitled to those weeks, do the following:
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent renewal. Unknown third party.”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Issue w/c [w/cs to which the client is entitled], CT [XX].” If paycoding is required, type “[Appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].”
If the renewal week that is on file is the renewal week requested by the client, there are cycling claimant’s reports that were completed by a third party and the client is entitled to some of those weeks:
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent renewal. Unknown third party.”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Remove cycling claimant’s reports w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Issue w/c [w/cs to which the client is entitled], CT [XX].” If paycoding is required, type “[Appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].
If the renewal week on file is different from the renewal week requested by the client and there are cycling claimant’s reports that were completed by a third party:
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent renewal. Unknown third party.”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Remove cycling claimant’s reports w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX]. Input renewal w/c [XXXX], CT [XX]. Issue w/c [w/cs to which the client is entitled].” If paycoding is required, type “[Appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].”
If the renewal week on file is different from the renewal week requested by the client and no cycling claimant’s reports were completed by a third party:
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent renewal. Unknown third party.”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Input renewal w/c [XXXX], CT [XX]. Issue w/c [w/cs to which the client is entitled].” If paycoding is required, type “[Appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].”
If the renewal week has not been input:
Remarks line 1: Type “Fraudulent renewal. Unknown third party.”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “Input renewal w/c [XXXX], CT [XX]. Issue w/c [w/cs to which the client is entitled].” If paycoding is required, type “[Appropriate paycoding, e.g. FWW, non-available days, sick days].” If there is an allocation, type “M175 [type] [amount] from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], [amount, if different from last week].” If a disentitlement must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If a disqualification must be imposed, type “D[XX] from w/c [XXXX].” If an MA was imposed to stop payments, type “Rescind MA[XX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine the type of WI:

ul.li: If it is a Level 1 AI WI, go to step 32.
If it is a Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI, go to step 36.

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD in the client’s application and not in the fraudulent application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Client’s identity validated — fraudulent renewal.”

Details: Type “The client’s identity, address and banking information were validated on: [DD-MM-YYYY]. The client’s address is: [client’s address]. The client’s banking information is: [client’s banking information].” Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD on the fraudulent renewal application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Fraudulent claim — renewal submitted by a third party.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI renewal application was filed by a third party on [DD-MM-YYYY] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This renewal application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: To delete the fraudulent application, create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Due date: Enter the next business day.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Select Specific user:
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person and select Find user .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the AI WI and all other related WIs. No further action is required.
Create a ROD in the client’s application and not in the fraudulent application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — fraudulent renewal.”

Details: Type “The investigator confirmed the client’s address and banking information on [DD-MM-YYYY]. The client’s address is: [client’s address]. The client’s banking information is: [client’s banking information].” If Integrity identified fraudulent ROEs, also type “Integrity confirmed that ROE [serial number] is fraudulent.” Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Create a ROD on the fraudulent renewal application as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity file number] — renewal submitted by a third party.”

Details: Enter the following information:
Relevant facts: Type “An EI renewal application was filed by a third party on [DD-MM-YYYY] using the client’s identity.”
Decision/Justification: Type “This renewal application was not filed by the client and must not be included in an access to information request.”

step.cmd: To delete the fraudulent application, create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Due date: Enter the next business day.
Destination — SCC: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

End user: Select Specific user:
Enter the name of the team leader or the designated person and select Find user .

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the IC70 Report of Investigation screen, close the case as follows:

ul.li:
Disentitlement: Select No .
Reason: Select Other and type “Client’s information has been corrected as required.”
Overpayment: Do not check either box.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the Integrity registration number has been completed:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the registration number as follows:

ul.li: Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the Level 1 CR Integrity - ERB-EI Transition WI and all other related WIs.
